title: The image of a rectifiable triple under the dilation η_{x,r} is a rectifiable triple
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (NVector), x ∈ ℝ^P and r > 0. If (M, θ, ξ) is a rectifiable triple in ℝ^P (IsRectifiableTriple univ n M θ ξ), then so is (η(M), θ′, ξ′) with η(y) = r⁻¹(y − x), θ′(z) = θ(x + r z), ξ′(z) = ξ(x + r z).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (x : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n M θ ξ → IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n ((fun y => r⁻¹ • (y - x)) '' M) (fun z => θ (x + r • z)) (fun z => ξ (x + r • z))
